correction.claim: BRENTOIL has exact live-canary execution evidence and must not be described as having no data.
correction.limitation: The largest winner was a manual close. The two autonomous breakout-pressure lifecycles lost $0.232469 in aggregate, so the canary establishes execution and friction evidence rather than repeatable strategy edge.
correction.falsifier: A reconciled ledger revision with different fill or lifecycle identity, or additional attributable autonomous closes that materially change largest-winner sensitivity, would update this assessment.

technical_evidence_fix.problem: The lifecycle research reader duplicated and narrowed the live candle/decision contract. It rejected valid noneligible post-start evidence and zero-volume source candles, preventing an honest lifecycle report.
technical_evidence_fix.scope: research evidence validation only; no live order, strategy, parameter, risk, route, or process behavior changed
technical_evidence_fix.remediation: The live writer and research reader now reuse one exact candle-row validator. Decision validation distinguishes retained noneligible context from eligible entry evidence.
failure_modes_remaining: No prospective onset has occurred, so entry and exit behavior remain untested for the challenger.
Funding is excluded from the lifecycle model.
Sparse clustered oil shocks may make the evidence window slow to mature.
Historical development stress economics were not robust and cannot be overridden by canary execution feasibility.
technical_evidence_fix.falsifier: Any accepted eligible decision lacking prospective timing or any source-complete candle rejected solely for being noneligible or zero-volume would reopen the validator defect.

next_investigation.4_observed_problem_or_opportunity: Execution data exists, but autonomous edge does not; the new mechanism has not yet emitted an eligible onset.
next_investigation.5_applicable_market_regime: Outside-U.S.-regular-hours 5m oil shock followed by fresh causal reversion onset under the frozen q95 threshold.
next_investigation.6_alternatives_considered: Restore Swing, restore Breakout Pressure, lower the shock threshold, transfer CL, or stop collecting BRENTOIL evidence.
next_investigation.8_expected_upside: Obtain mechanism-specific live-source entry, exit, friction, direction, and giveback evidence without risking capital.
next_investigation.9_main_risks_and_failure_modes: Sparse onsets, clustered regimes, source mismatch, incomplete mark paths, outlier dependence, and misleading manual-close attribution.
next_investigation.10_validation_completed: Canary execution feasibility, exact strategy attribution, shared source-contract repair, and 46 focused passing tests.
next_investigation.11_validation_still_required: Resolved long and short lifecycles with exact paths and costs, stress robustness after largest-winner removal, and untouched OOS evidence.
next_investigation.12_success_metrics: Positive stress net and PF above one after complete costs and largest-winner removal, independently nonnegative sides, zero unresolved paths, and incremental portfolio benefit.
next_investigation.13_failure_or_rollback_triggers: Identity drift, retroactive signal, unresolved path used economically, nonpositive stress robustness, or one-side-only pooled edge. No rollback is needed because no live change exists.
next_investigation.14_confidence_level: High on canary data availability and execution evidence; high on validator repair; low on repeatable profitability.
